name: project.open
description: Open a .aep project file. Closes the current project without saving.

params.name: save
params.description: Save current project before closing (default false)

name: project.import_file
description: Import a file (image, video, audio) into the project as footage. Pass sequence=true with the first file of an image sequence to import the whole sequence.

params.name: sequence
params.description: Import as image sequence starting at path (default false)

params.name: forceAlphabetical
params.description: Sequence only: force alphabetical order (default false)

params.name: importAs
params.description: footage|comp|compRetainLayerSizes|project — for layered files like .psd/.ai (default footage)

params.name: rangeStart
params.description: Sequence only: first frame number to import (ImportOptions.rangeStart)

params.name: rangeEnd
params.description: Sequence only: last frame number to import (ImportOptions.rangeEnd)

name: project.undo
description: Undo the last action. Equivalent to Ctrl+Z. Each prior ae_do call is ONE undo step (its automatic undo group), so count=1 reverts the whole previous call, batch included.

name: project.purge
description: Purge AE memory/disk caches. Use when AE is consuming too much RAM.

name: project.replace_font
description: Replace a font throughout the entire project. Useful for font substitution.

params.name: fromFont
params.description: Current font postscript name to replace

name: project.auto_fix_expressions
description: Find and replace text in all expressions across the project. Useful after renaming layers/comps.

name: project.clear
description: Remove ALL items from the project. Destructive — use with caution.

name: project.delete_item
description: Delete a project item by id.

name: project.find_layers
description: Search layers by name pattern and/or type across one or all comps.

params.name: comp
params.description: Restrict to one comp (name or id). Omit to search all.

params.name: namePattern
params.description: Case-insensitive substring match on layer name

name: project.list_effects
description: List available effect matchNames in the running AE. Uses app.effects if available, otherwise a curated list.

name: project.set_settings
description: Set project-wide settings: color depth, expression engine, working color space, time display.

params.name: workingSpace
params.description: Working color space name (see project.get_settings includeColorProfiles), or '' for None

params.name: displayStartFrame
params.description: Frame count starts at 0 or 1 (when counting frames)

name: project.get_settings
description: Read project-wide settings: color depth, expression engine, working color space, time display. Pass includeColorProfiles=true to list installed color profile names.

params.name: includeColorProfiles
params.description: Also return installed color profile names (default false)

name: project.reduce
description: Reduce the project to only the given comps and everything they use (Project.reduceProject). Removes all other items — save a copy first.

params.name: comps
params.description: Comp names or ids to keep

name: project.remove_unused_footage
description: Remove all footage items that are not used in any comp (Project.removeUnusedFootage).

name: project.consolidate_footage
description: Merge duplicate footage items into one and update layer references (Project.consolidateFootage).

name: project.import_placeholder
description: Create a placeholder footage item (Project.importPlaceholder) to build comps before the real footage exists. Relink later with footage.replace.

name: project.new
description: Create a NEW empty project (app.newProject). Closes the current project — pass save=true to save it first (only works when it has a file path). Destructive to unsaved work.

params.name: save
params.description: Save the current project before closing (default false; needs a file path)

name: project.parse_swatch
description: Parse an Adobe swatch file (.ase) and return its colors (app.parseSwatchFile) - feed brand palettes to fills, solids, and text colors.

name: project.get_xmp
description: Read the project's XMP metadata packet (Project.xmpPacket) as an RDF/XML string.

name: project.set_xmp
description: Replace the project's XMP metadata packet (Project.xmpPacket). Pass a complete, well-formed RDF/XML packet - AE does not validate fragments.

name: project.set_default_import_folder
description: Set the folder shown by default in the file import dialog (Project.setDefaultImportFolder).

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

name: project.get_tool
description: Read the active tool in the Tools panel (Project.toolType, AE 14.0+).

name: project.set_tool
description: Set the active tool in the Tools panel (Project.toolType, AE 14.0+): selection|rotate|hand|zoom|panBehind|rect|roundedRect|ellipse|polygon|star|textHorizontal|textVertical|pen|maskFeather|brush|cloneStamp|eraser|puppetPin|puppetStarch|puppetBend|puppetAdvanced|puppetOverlap|cameraUnified|cameraOrbit|cameraTrackXY|cameraTrackZ|cameraOrbitCursor|cameraOrbitScene|cameraOrbitCamera|cameraPanCursor.

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

name: project.set_memory_limits
description: Set AE memory usage limits (app.setMemoryUsageLimits): image cache percent and maximum memory percent. Percentages over 100 are allowed (AE interprets them against installed RAM).

params.name: imageCachePercent
params.description: Image cache size as % of installed RAM

params.name: maxMemoryPercent
params.description: Maximum AE memory as % of installed RAM

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

name: project.set_multi_frame_rendering
description: Configure Multi-Frame Rendering (app.setMultiFrameRenderingConfig, AE 22.0+): on/off and the maximum CPU percentage MFR may use.

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

name: text.set_content
description: Set the text content of a text layer.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index or name (must be a TextLayer)

name: text.set_style
description: Set text styling on the whole document: font, fontSize, colors, tracking, leading, justification, caps, kerning, ligatures, paragraph indents/spacing, RTL direction, vertical baselines, digit set, and more. For a sub-range use text.set_style_range.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: allCaps
params.description: All caps via fontCapsOption (setter needs AE 24.0+)

params.name: smallCaps
params.description: Small caps via fontCapsOption (setter needs AE 24.0+)

params.name: tsume
params.description: Tsume (normalized 0-1, CJK spacing, setter needs AE 24.0+)

name: text.set_style_range
description: Style a SUB-RANGE of a text layer (AE 24.3+): same attributes as text.set_style, applied to characters, paragraphs, or composed lines. Whole-document-only attributes (lineOrientation) are rejected by AE with a warning.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: start
params.description: 0-based start index (character, paragraph, or composed line)

params.name: end
params.description: Exclusive end index. Default: characters → end of text; paragraphs/lines → start+1

params.name: allCaps
params.description: All caps via fontCapsOption (setter needs AE 24.0+)

params.name: smallCaps
params.description: Small caps via fontCapsOption (setter needs AE 24.0+)

params.name: tsume
params.description: Tsume (normalized 0-1, CJK spacing, setter needs AE 24.0+)

name: text.measure
description: Measure a text layer's composed layout: line/paragraph counts and character spans, per-line baselines (baselineLocs), box overflow. Range data needs AE 24.3+; missing fields come back null.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: text.set_box
description: Resize, reposition, or configure the box of a paragraph (box) text layer, including the AE 24.6 auto-fit and alignment controls. Point<->box conversion is NOT scriptable in AE — create the layer as box text from the start (layer.create_text with boxSize).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: boxPosition
params.description: [x, y] top-left of the box in layer space (AE 14.0+)

params.name: firstBaselineAlignmentMinimum
params.description: Manual minimum offset of the first composed line (AE 24.6+)

params.name: insetSpacing
params.description: Inset spacing between box bounds and text, px (AE 24.6+)

name: text.set_variable_font
description: Set variable-font design axes on a text layer (AE 24.0+). axes maps axis tags to values, e.g. { "wght": 700, "wdth": 85 }. Unspecified axes keep their current values. Discover a font's axes with font.info (designAxesData).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: text.add_font_axis
description: Add a variable-font axis property to a text animator (PropertyGroup.addVariableFontAxis, AE 26.0+) so the axis can be animated/keyframed. Targets an existing animator by 1-based index or name, or creates a new one.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: animator
params.description: Existing animator (1-based index or name). Omit to create a new animator.

name: text.add_animator
description: Add a text animator with animated properties and a selector. properties maps animator matchNames to initial values, e.g. {"ADBE Text Position 3D": [0,-50,0], "ADBE Text Opacity": 0}. Common: Position 3D, Scale 3D, Rotation, Opacity, Fill Color, Tracking Amount, Blur.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name (must be a TextLayer)

params.name: properties
params.description: Map of animator-property matchName to initial value

name: text.paste_range
description: Paste the TEXT AND STYLING of one character range into another (CharacterRange.pasteFrom, AE 25.1+) — replaces the target range's content. Source defaults to the same layer; pass sourceLayer to copy across layers.

params.name: layer
params.description: TARGET text layer (1-based index or name)

params.name: end
params.description: Target range end (exclusive; default: end of text)

params.name: sourceLayer
params.description: SOURCE text layer (default: same as layer)

params.name: sourceEnd
params.description: Source range end (exclusive; default: end of source text)

name: text.reset_style
description: Reset a text layer's styling to the default Character and/or Paragraph panel settings (TextDocument.resetCharStyle / resetParagraphStyle).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: layer.create_solid
description: Create a solid layer in a composition.

name: layer.create_shape
description: Create an empty shape layer.

name: layer.create_text
description: Create a text layer: point text by default, paragraph (box) text when boxSize is given, vertical when orientation='vertical' (AE 24.2+). Point<->box conversion is not scriptable, so pick the right kind here.

params.name: boxSize
params.description: [width, height] — creates paragraph (box) text instead of point text

params.name: boxPosition
params.description: [x, y] top-left of the box in layer space (box text only)

name: layer.create_null
description: Create a null object layer.

name: layer.create_camera
description: Create a camera layer.

name: layer.create_light
description: Create a light layer.

name: layer.create_parametric_mesh
description: Create a parametric 3D mesh layer (LayerCollection.addParametricMesh, AE 26.3+): cube|sphere|plane|cylinder|cone|torus. Best rendered with the Advanced 3D renderer (comp.set_renderer).

name: layer.delete
description: Delete layers. comp supports pattern ('review_id_*'). layer supports index, name, 'selected', 'all'.

name: layer.duplicate
description: Duplicate a layer. Returns the new layer's index.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: layer.set_parent
description: Set or clear a layer's parent. By default AE compensates the child's transform so it doesn't move; jump=true skips compensation (setParentWithJump) so the child adopts the parent's space.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based child layer index, or the layer name

params.name: parentLayer
params.description: 1-based parent layer index or name. Pass null or 0 to unparent.

params.name: jump
params.description: true = no transform compensation (setParentWithJump). Default false.

name: layer.scene_edit_detection
description: Run Scene Edit Detection on a video layer (Layer.doSceneEditDetection, AE 22.3+): find cuts in edited footage and mark or split at them.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: mode
params.description: markers (add layer markers) | split (split layer) | splitPrecomp (split + precompose each) | none (detect only)

name: layer.move
description: Move a layer to a new stacking position (1 = top).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based current layer index, or the layer name

name: layer.create_footage
description: Add an existing project item (footage or comp) as a layer in a composition.

params.name: sourceItemId
params.description: Project item id to use as source

name: layer.set_enabled
description: Enable or disable a layer by name or index. Can target all comps matching a pattern.

params.name: comp
params.description: Comp name/id, or '*' for all comps, or 'review_id_*' for pattern match

name: layer.set_guide
description: Set guideLayer on/off for a layer. Can target all comps matching a pattern.

params.name: comp
params.description: Comp name/id, or '*' for all comps, or 'review_id_*' for pattern match

name: layer.set_props
description: Set basic layer properties. layer can be index, name, 'selected', or 'all'. Enum-valued attributes accept string names: quality (best|draft|wireframe), samplingQuality (bilinear|bicubic), frameBlendingType (off|frameMix|pixelMotion), autoOrient (off|alongPath|cameraOrPointOfInterest|charactersTowardCamera), blendingMode, lightType (spot|parallel|point|ambient|environment).

params.name: props
params.description: Object with keys to set, e.g. { name: 'foo', enabled: false, label: 5, threeDLayer: true }

name: layer.add_guide
description: Add a ruler guide to a layer's Layer panel view (Layer.addGuide, AE 16.1+). Comp-panel guides live under comp.add_guide.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: position
params.description: Position in px (y for horizontal, x for vertical)

name: layer.remove_guide
description: Remove a Layer-panel ruler guide by its 0-based index (see layer.list_guides).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: layer.move_guide
description: Move an existing Layer-panel ruler guide to a new position (Layer.setGuide). Named move_guide because layer.set_guide already means the guide-LAYER flag.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: layer.list_guides
description: List a layer's Layer-panel ruler guides with orientation and position (AE 16.1+).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: layer.bounds
description: Measure a layer's rendered bounds via sourceRectAtTime — essential for aligning/fitting text and shape layers. Returns layer-space rect and, when the host supports it, comp-space corners.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: time
params.description: Time in seconds (default: current comp time)

params.name: includeExtents
params.description: Include pixel extents beyond the layer edges (default false)

name: layer.convert_point
description: Convert a point between layer source space and comp space (sourcePointToComp / compPointToSource, AE 13.2+; designed for text layers — evaluates at the first character at the given time).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: time
params.description: Evaluate at this time (default: current comp time)

name: layer.apply_preset
description: Apply an animation preset (.ffx file) to a layer — applies effects/keyframes in one call.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: layer.replace_source
description: Replace a layer's source with another project item (footage or comp), keeping keyframes/effects. Set fixExpressions=false to skip expression rewriting.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: item
params.description: New source: project item id (number) or name (string)

params.name: fixExpressions
params.description: Rewrite expressions that reference the old source (default true)

name: layer.set_track_matte
description: Set (or remove) a track matte on a layer. Uses AVLayer.setTrackMatte (AE 23.0+): the matte can be ANY layer in the comp — it does not need to sit directly above the target.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based index (or name) of the layer to apply matte TO

params.name: matteLayer
params.description: Matte source layer: 1-based index or name. Ignored when matteType is 'none'.

name: layer.set_blend_mode
description: Set blending mode on a layer.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: layer.split
description: Split a layer at a given time. Creates a new layer that starts at the split time.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: time
params.description: Time in seconds to split at

name: layer.copy_to_comp
description: Copy a layer from one comp to another.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index (or name) in source comp

name: layer.calculate_transform
description: Calculate the transform that maps a 3D layer onto three corner points (AVLayer.calculateTransformFromPoints) - corner-pin style placement in 3D space. Calculation-only: returns anchorPoint/position/x-y-zRotation/scale without touching the layer — apply them with property.set / layer.set_props.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name (3D layer)

params.name: topLeft
params.description: [x,y,z] world point for the layer's top-left

params.name: bottomLeft
params.description: [x,y,z] world point for the bottom-left. The scripting guide names this pointBottomRight, but the implementation expects the bottom-left (the guide's own example passes bl): a true bottom-right returns the same placement with zScale skewed by sin(corner angle) — verified on AE 26.3.

name: layer.info
description: Full layer info incl. property trees and keyframes (same payload as ae_layer_info). Layer by 1-based index or name. includeProperties=false for the cheap summary.

params.name: includeProperties
params.description: Walk the full property tree (default true)

name: comp.create
description: Create a new composition.

name: comp.set_label
description: Set label color on comps. Can target by name, id, or pattern (e.g. 'review_id_*').

params.name: comp
params.description: Comp name/id, or pattern with '*' wildcard

name: comp.set_props
description: Set composition properties (bgColor, workAreaStart, workAreaDuration, shutterAngle, motionBlur, etc.).

name: comp.set_renderer
description: Switch a comp's 3D renderer: classic3d | advanced3d | cinema4d (or a raw matchName from comp.list_renderers). Advanced 3D is required for 3D model layers, parametric meshes, and environment lights to render.

params.name: renderer
params.description: classic3d|advanced3d|cinema4d, or an exact renderer matchName

name: comp.list_renderers
description: List the comp's available 3D renderer matchNames, the current one, and the friendly-name mapping used by comp.set_renderer.

name: comp.set_work_area
description: Set the work area start and duration on a composition.

name: comp.add_guide
description: Add a horizontal or vertical guide line to a comp (AE 16.1+).

params.name: position
params.description: Position in px (y for horizontal, x for vertical)

name: comp.remove_guide
description: Remove a guide from a comp by its 0-based index (see comp.list_guides).

name: comp.set_guide
description: Move an existing guide to a new position (Item.setGuide). Orientation cannot be changed after creation — remove and re-add instead.

params.name: position
params.description: New position in px (y for horizontal, x for vertical)

name: comp.list_guides
description: List all guides on a comp with orientation and position (AE 16.1+).

name: comp.delete
description: Delete a composition from the project.

name: comp.precompose
description: Pre-compose selected layers into a new nested composition.

params.name: layerIndices
params.description: Array of 1-based layer indices to precompose

params.name: moveAll
params.description: Move all attributes into new comp (default true)

name: comp.duplicate
description: Duplicate a composition.

params.name: comp
params.description: Comp name or id to duplicate

name: comp.info
description: Comp details + per-layer summaries (same payload as ae_comp_info). As a batch.run child, lets the same call verify what a preceding mutation did.

name: keyframe.add
description: Add a keyframe at a specific time with a value.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: keyframe.remove
description: Remove a keyframe by its 1-based index.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: keyframe.set_easing
description: Apply easing to a keyframe. Preset: 'linear', 'ease', 'easeIn', 'easeOut', 'hold'. Or custom bezier with inSpeed/outSpeed/inInfluence/outInfluence.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: keyframe.set_batch
description: Set many keyframes on one property in a single call (Property.setValuesAtTimes). times and values must have the same length.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: keyframe.shift
description: Retime all keyframes on a property: newTime = (time - pivot) * scale + pivot + offset. Preserves interpolation, ease, and spatial tangents best-effort.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: pivot
params.description: Pivot time in seconds for scaling (default 0)

name: keyframe.copy
description: Copy all keyframes from one property to another (same or different layer/comp). Value types must be compatible. Existing target keys are kept.

params.name: targetProperty
params.description: Target property path (default: same as source)

params.name: timeOffset
params.description: Seconds to add to every copied key time (default 0)

name: keyframe.set_spatial
description: Set spatial tangents / continuity on a keyframe of a spatial property (Position, Anchor Point). Tangents are [x,y] or [x,y,z] offsets.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: keyframe.set_roving
description: Set a keyframe to rove across time (smooth speed on a spatial path). First and last keyframes cannot rove.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: keyframe.set_value
description: Change the value of an existing keyframe without changing its time.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: keyframe.set_interpolation
description: Set a keyframe's in/out interpolation types directly (linear|bezier|hold — asymmetric combinations allowed, e.g. bezier in / hold out), and the temporal continuous / auto-bezier flags. For speed/influence curves use keyframe.set_easing.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: temporalAutoBezier
params.description: Temporal auto-bezier flag (true also enables continuity)

name: keyframe.set_label
description: Set a keyframe's label color (Property.setLabelAtKey, AE 22.6+).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: keyframe.set_selected
description: Select or deselect keyframes on a property (Property.setSelectedAtKey) - e.g. to stage keys for a user-facing copy/paste in the UI.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: render.add_to_queue
description: Add a composition to the render queue. Optionally set output path.

params.name: outputPath
params.description: Output file path (optional, sets on the first output module)

name: render.start
description: Start rendering the render queue. Blocks until complete.

name: render.clear_queue
description: Remove all items from the render queue.

name: render.set_output
description: Configure a render-queue item: render/output templates, output path, time span, render flag, skipFrames, logType, postRenderAction. Discover template names with render.list_templates; raw settings via render.get_settings / render.set_settings.

params.name: renderTemplate
params.description: Render settings template name (e.g. "Best Settings", "Draft Settings")

params.name: timeSpanStart
params.description: Render span start in seconds (comp time)

params.name: render
params.description: Whether this item renders when the queue starts (the Render checkbox)

params.name: skipFrames
params.description: Render every Nth frame (0 = every frame)

params.name: includeSourceXMP
params.description: Embed source-footage XMP metadata in the output

name: render.get_settings
description: Read the raw render settings of a queue item and the settings of each of its output modules (getSettings, AE 13.0+). format 'settable' returns only keys accepted by render.set_settings / render.set_om_settings.

name: render.set_settings
description: Set raw render settings on a queue item (RenderQueueItem.setSettings, AE 13.0+), e.g. { "Quality": "Best", "Resolution": "Half" }. Discover valid keys/values with render.get_settings.

name: render.set_om_settings
description: Set raw output-module settings on a queue item (OutputModule.setSettings, AE 13.0+), e.g. { "Format": "QuickTime", "Channels": "RGB + Alpha" }. Discover valid keys/values with render.get_settings.

name: render.remove_item
description: Remove ONE item from the render queue by its 1-based index (render.clear_queue removes all).

params.name: queueIndex
params.description: 1-based queue item index (explicit — no default for a destructive op)

name: render.duplicate_item
description: Duplicate a render-queue item (RenderQueueItem.duplicate) — e.g. to render the same comp with a second settings/output combination.

name: render.list_templates
description: List available render-settings templates and output-module templates. The render queue must have at least one item (templates are read from a queue item).

name: render.status
description: Report the render queue state: per-item status, time spans, and output paths.

name: render.queue_in_ame
description: Send the render queue to Adobe Media Encoder (for H.264/HEVC etc.). Requires AME installed. renderImmediately=true starts the AME queue.

params.name: renderImmediately
params.description: Start rendering in AME right away (default false)

name: render.save_template
description: Save a queue item's current render settings, or an output module's current settings, as a named template (saveAsTemplate) for reuse via render.set_output.

params.name: confirm
params.description: Must be true. This operation changes the user's After Effects APPLICATION configuration (it persists beyond the project) — set it only when the user explicitly requested this change, never as a side effect of other work.

name: render.frame
description: Render one frame to PNG (raw saveFrameToPng). As the LAST child of a batch.run, one call mutates and hands back visual proof. outPath must be absolute; raise ae_do's timeoutMs for slow renders. CAUTION: in color-managed projects (project.get_settings workingSpace != 'None') this writes raw working-space values that look dark/wrong — use the ae_render_frame TOOL there, which converts to display sRGB.

params.name: outPath
params.description: Absolute path for the PNG (parent directories are created)

name: effect.add
description: Add an effect to a layer by matchName. Use ae_do project.list_effects (or effect.list_on_layer on a reference layer) to find matchNames.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: name
params.description: Custom display name for the effect

name: effect.remove
description: Remove an effect by its 1-based index within the layer's Effects group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: effect.list_on_layer
description: List all effects currently applied to a layer with their matchNames and properties.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: effect.set_property
description: Set a property value on an effect. Property path is relative to the effect (e.g. ['Blurriness'] for Gaussian Blur).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: time
params.description: If set, creates a keyframe at this time

name: effect.move
description: Reorder an effect within a layer's effect stack (PropertyBase.moveTo). Effect order changes the render result.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: effectIndex
params.description: 1-based index of the effect to move

name: effect.set_dropdown_items
description: Set the menu items of a Dropdown Menu Control effect (Property.setPropertyParameters, AE 17.0.1+) — the key API for MOGRT dropdowns. Item strings must be unique; "-" inserts a separator. AE re-creates the control (references from earlier calls become invalid); this op preserves the effect's display name across that re-creation.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: effect
params.description: 1-based effect index or effect name (a Dropdown Menu Control)

name: effect.get_dropdown_items
description: Read a Dropdown Menu Control's items (Property.propertyParameters, AE 26.0+), current 1-based selection, and its text (valueText).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: effect
params.description: 1-based effect index or effect name (a Dropdown Menu Control)

name: property.set
description: Set any layer property by path. layer can be index, name, 'selected', or 'all'.

name: property.get
description: Get the current value of any layer property by path.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: time
params.description: If set, get value at this time (for animated properties)

name: property.list
description: List child properties/groups at a given path. Useful for discovering what's inside a property group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: property
params.description: Property path to a group. Use [] for the layer root.

name: property.add
description: Add a property to an indexed group by matchName (PropertyGroup.addProperty). Unlocks text animators ('ADBE Text Animator' on ["Text","Animators"]), layer styles, shape contents, etc. Use property.list to discover group paths.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: property
params.description: Path to the group to add into, e.g. ["Text","Animators"]. Use [] for layer root.

params.name: matchName
params.description: Match name (or display name) of the property to add, e.g. "ADBE Text Animator". NOTE: adding to an indexed group re-creates it, invalidating prior property references.

name: property.remove
description: Remove a property or group by path (Property.remove). Works on members of indexed groups: effects, masks, shape contents, text animators, layer styles.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: property
params.description: Path to the property to remove

name: property.separate_dimensions
description: Separate (or rejoin) the dimensions of a multi-dimensional property such as Position. When separated, animate the followers (e.g. X Position) individually.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: property.move
description: Reorder a property within its parent INDEXED group (PropertyBase.moveTo): masks, shape contents, text animators. For effects use effect.move.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: property
params.description: Path to the property to move (a member of an indexed group)

params.name: toIndex
params.description: 1-based target position within the parent group

name: property.select
description: Select or deselect a property in the timeline (PropertyBase.selected) - stages it for UI-side actions and makes it visible with the U-shortcut workflow.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_group
description: Add a Vector Group to a shape layer's Contents.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index or name (must be a shape layer)

name: shape.add_rect
description: Add a Rectangle Path to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_ellipse
description: Add an Ellipse Path to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_fill
description: Add a Fill to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_path
description: Add a custom bezier Path (vertices + tangents) to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_trim_paths
description: Add Trim Paths to a shape group. Essential for shape animation (line draw-on effects).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_merge_paths
description: Add Merge Paths to a shape group for combining/subtracting shapes.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_stroke
description: Add a Stroke to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_polystar
description: Add a Polystar Path (star or polygon) to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: innerRadius
params.description: Inner radius in px (star type only)

name: shape.add_repeater
description: Add a Repeater to a shape group — duplicates the group's contents with a per-copy transform offset.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_rounded_corners
description: Add Rounded Corners to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_offset_paths
description: Add Offset Paths to a shape group (grow/shrink outlines).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: amount
params.description: Offset in px (positive grows, negative shrinks)

name: shape.add_wiggle_paths
description: Add Wiggle Paths (roughen) to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_zigzag
description: Add Zig Zag to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_pucker_bloat
description: Add Pucker & Bloat to a shape group (negative = pucker, positive = bloat).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_twist
description: Add Twist to a shape group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_gradient_fill
description: Add a Gradient Fill to a shape group. Type and start/end points are scriptable; color stops are NOT scriptable in AE (defaults to white-to-black — edit stops manually or via a preset).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_gradient_stroke
description: Add a Gradient Stroke to a shape group. Type, points, and width are scriptable; color stops are NOT scriptable in AE.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: shape.add_wiggle_transform
description: Add Wiggle Transform to a shape group - randomizes position/scale/rotation over time (the transform-space sibling of Wiggle Paths).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

name: transform.set
description: Set transform properties on one or more layers. layer can be index, name, 'selected', or 'all'. For keyframes use keyframe.add.
